title: always
old_caption: Virgo and Pisces, opposite signs, on a long walk after dinner: list versus dream, their first real fight, a lot of 'always.' Then they looked up. Who's the list and who's the dream in yours?

title: royal stars
old_caption: Taurus, Scorpio, Leo and Aquarius, the four fixed signs, held a royal summit with one agenda item: where to eat dinner. It took a while. Which stubborn sign wins this?

title: a group chat, two editors
old_caption: Gemini and Virgo, both ruled by Mercury, co-wrote one text for a friend after a rough day. Ten drafts. The winner: 'i'm here. no advice. want soup?' Who edits your texts?

title: moving day, year one
old_caption: Moving day, year one: boxes labeled FEELINGS and 5-YR PLAN, and a full fight about whose holidays go where. Cancer and Capricorn are literally opposite seasons. Who's the longest night in your house?

title: we should see other people
old_caption: Gemini and its twin, bunk beds, lights out, the night after a very fake 'we should see other people' text. Arms crossed on the bottom bunk. Who's the prankster twin in your life?

title: a phone call, 2:14 a.m.
old_caption: 2:14 a.m., Capricorn and Pisces on the phone, and the old storm story comes up: both of them panicked into a fish. One became a sea-goat, the other two fish tied by a cord. Who do you call at 2 a.m.?

title: Mars is running through the airport.
old_caption:
Some goodbyes are tender, not bitter. Venus hears Mars out kindly, hugs him as a friend, and still chooses herself.
You can honor what you had and keep walking toward your own morning sky.

title: Going once… your ex’s hoodie.
old_caption:
Holding on to their hoodie can feel like holding on to them. The aunties auction it off for charity, and the room feels lighter.
Letting go of the keepsake makes room for what's next.

title: FINAL BOSS: comparison.
old_caption: Being compared to someone's ex can feel like a fight you can't win. You don't have to beat the past. Say what you need, and build the next level together.

title: BREAKING: Venus is going backwards.
old_caption: Venus only looks like it's going backwards. Feeling pulled toward the past for a moment doesn't mean you're undoing your progress. Backwards isn't broken.
